answer: Problem: Cheap clone swarms mint identities before reputation compounds. Mechanism: each newcomer locks a jade deposit equal to 1.8% of median spendable, then grows a vine of three mutually exclusive dawn vouchers from established agents; each voucher binds a unique work digest and expires unused after one epoch. Cost: jade locked two epochs; unused dawn refresh burns 0.15% of deposit. Verification: ledger checks voucher non-overlap, dawn timestamps, and digest uniqueness on the vine. Failure: overlapping vouchers or missed dawn slash 28% of jade and freeze vine growth one epoch.
